name: Tamura Chihaya
source: Reserved and weak-willed housewife but always thinking of her family the most. She is strong and reliable mother when it comes to her daughter Hina. Because her husband always works until late and she also has to work to support the family, she relies on the protagonist to take care of Hina without knowing he has feeling for her.
